discover.task: Map the diff and changed modules; write context.md listing files, entry points and risks.

api-review.task: Review public API surface changes for breaking changes and consistency; write api-review.md with a verdict line starting with APPROVED or CHANGES.

test-review.task: Review test coverage of the changed modules; write test-review.md with a verdict line starting with APPROVED or CHANGES.

synthesis.task: Cross-check the findings in {artifacts}, reconcile disagreements, and write final-review.md with a verdict line starting with APPROVED or CHANGES.

fix-body.task: Apply the changes required by final-review.md, re-run the tests, and update final-review.md so its verdict line reads APPROVED.

done.task: Summarize the review outcome and artifact hashes into DONE.md.
